method: Static review of the skill body and both prompt templates; no agent launch or workflow execution. Dispositions are reasoning checks, not live behavioral tests.

cases.prompt: Exact candidate/tree/base unchanged; full reviewer report and all expected payloads are appended to the same-HEAD note, hashes and readback pass. What happens next?
cases.disposition: Worker/orchestrator verifies complete storage and hands off; no automatic second acknowledgement, report-only commit or review cycle. Any concrete unresolved condition is handled explicitly.

cases.prompt: Review finds a material correctness defect and worker commits a fix. Can old approval carry to new HEAD?
cases.disposition: No. SAME clean-context reviewer disposes exact new HEAD/base and actual fix delta with affected meaningful checks; full initial/final reports/failures survive.

cases.prompt: Main advances; candidate rebases without conflicts. Can a watermark advance from rebase alone?
cases.disposition: No. Examine accepted delta and reconcile all task overlap; SAME reviewer explicitly disposes exact new HEAD/base. Rebase is not examination.

cases.prompt: A visual card is blocked at its finite stop. An independent isolated export preparation is ready. Must it wait? Can independently verified isolated workspace editors write in parallel?
cases.disposition: Stop/report visual access gap. Independent ready work proceeds under named ownership, separate writer leases and conflicting-review serialization; no broad repair or unchanged retry. One writer per SAME shared editor/MCP/source asset, not global Godot. Private worktree editor endpoints may write in parallel after ports/routes/process/resource isolation confirmation; worktrees alone or read-only capability inspection are not proof or launch grants.

cases.prompt: Included payload hashes pass but a required empty stderr and initial failed checker are missing. Is storage complete?
cases.disposition: No. Compare actual against full declared expected set; return the exact two gaps, preserve prior payloads and correct storage. No broad filter or shortened report. Escalate material evidence/condition change to SAME reviewer.

cases.prompt: Report retention is committed into the candidate tree. Does the metadata-only exception apply?
cases.disposition: No. Tree/HEAD changed; SAME reviewer gives compact exact-new-HEAD/base retention delta disposition.

cases.prompt: Resume after one trivial accepted docs correction; prior checkpoint watermark remains an ancestor. Is a full audit required?
cases.disposition: Cheap watermark/main/handoff/cadence check; do not infer a full audit from tiny commit count.

cases.prompt: Three small workstreams include a stopped observation with unchanged conditions, docs reconciliation and retention. Is a full checkpoint due? When is it due?
cases.disposition: No full check from this batch alone. Normal full check at roughly6–8 substantive integrated experiment/feature/decision workstreams or milestone transition; docs/retention/reviewfix/lifecycle alone excluded. Earlier only consequential scope/dependency/feasibility/gate/product/phase evidence. Cheap ordinary acceptance/deps/ownership/docs/watermark check; profile assessment at full check or meaningful routing/capability/requirements drift, no inventories/manufactured specialist/install.

cases.prompt: A material stale canonical claim is found while another worker owns related ready implementation. Who fixes it?
cases.disposition: Create a scoped docs TODO naming exact files/evidence/prereqs/owner/measurable done/resolving removal; reconcile active work first, no duplicate implementation allocation or silent guide repair. Cross-cutting stale docs alone can become a scoped task without a full checkpoint.
